business_problem: Lexmark's places a premium on customer engagement but its legacy solutions were disparate, making tracking customer journeys complex and inefficient.
solution_summary: Lexmark used Dynamics 365 Sales, Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Dynamics 365 Field Service to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Customer and service data that had been scattered across CRM, service, and support tools were consolidated into Dynamics 365 so sales, case handling, dispatch, and reporting could run on a single omnichannel platform. It also connects with surrounding systems such as Salesforce, Siebel, SAP S4/Hana, which lets the new Azure-based workflow fit into existing operations rather than standing apart from them. Lexmark is a global leader in innovative, cloud-enabled printing, imaging, and IoT products, software, solutions and services.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Sales
solution_components.role: Manages the sales pipeline, account context, and forecasting in one cloud CRM workflow.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Customer Service
solution_components.role: Provides the unified service workspace for cases, omnichannel interactions, and customer history.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Field Service
solution_components.role: Coordinates work orders, field dispatch, and downstream service execution.

solution_components.name: Experlogix CPQ
solution_components.role: Generates accurate configurations and quotes that stay synchronized with CRM processes.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Delivers dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics to business users.

data_flow: Operational data lands in the Azure analytics platform, is modeled for analytics, and is served through Power BI so teams can query current business performance and act on a shared source of truth.
